title: Database / Data Contract / Storage Engineering for Trading AI
audit_goal: 请审计 Phase 42 是否应作为 AI Engineering 下的数据库、数据契约、存储工程知识分支；检查 12 个 L3 专题、34 条知识点、跨分支边界、禁止事项和后续采集顺序是否合理。

proposed_l2_node.title: Database Data Contract And Storage Engineering
proposed_l2_node.purpose: 为交易 AI、LLM gating/scoring、RAG 检索和审计工作流提供数据库、数据契约、审计日志、向量库、迁移、备份恢复和数据生命周期治理知识。

proposed_l3_nodes.title: Relational Core Schema
proposed_l3_nodes.scope: 核心关系表、主键、唯一键、外键、约束、JSONB 边界和幂等键。

proposed_l3_nodes.title: Migration Versioning
proposed_l3_nodes.scope: Alembic、migration review、reversible migration、rollback 和兼容性检查。

proposed_l3_nodes.title: Indexing Query Performance
proposed_l3_nodes.scope: 查询模式驱动索引、复合索引、唯一索引、分区、分页和慢查询审计。

proposed_l3_nodes.title: Feature Store Storage
proposed_l3_nodes.scope: offline/online parity、feature snapshot、feature manifest、point-in-time join 和 feature-store 条件引入。

proposed_l3_nodes.title: Vector Store Retrieval Storage
proposed_l3_nodes.scope: pgvector/Qdrant、embedding version、chunk metadata、payload filter、source provenance 和 index version。

proposed_l3_nodes.title: Model Registry Release Storage
proposed_l3_nodes.scope: model release manifest、scorer、calibrator、threshold、prompt、RAG index、rollback target 和 model registry 条件引入。

proposed_l3_nodes.title: Data Lifecycle Retention
proposed_l3_nodes.scope: retention、archive、delete、cold storage、dataset freeze、incident freeze 和 audit replay continuity。

proposed_l3_nodes.title: Security Privacy Access Control
proposed_l3_nodes.scope: least privilege、RLS、pgAudit、secret exclusion、PII/private field redaction 和 audited writes。

proposed_l3_nodes.title: Backup Restore Disaster Recovery
proposed_l3_nodes.scope: backup、restore drill、RPO/RTO、disaster recovery evidence 和恢复失败处理。

p0_topics: P42-P0-001 canonical records must live in PostgreSQL, not vector DB
P42-P0-002 every scoring/gating decision must have audit_trace_id
P42-P0-003 final_gate decision must be append-only
P42-P0-004 score_result must be versioned append-only
P42-P0-005 trade_candidate snapshot must contain only decision-time visible fields
P42-P0-006 outcome must be isolated from input features
P42-P0-007 feedback/outcome/label must be separated
P42-P0-008 labels must record label_policy_version and label_source
P42-P0-009 model_version/prompt_version/rag_index_version must be recorded together
P42-P0-010 LLM audit output must bind citations/source/version
P42-P0-011 vector search result must link back to source document and formal knowledge id
P42-P0-012 RAG chunks must store source_uri/license/hash/chunk_version
P42-P0-013 embedding_model_version must be stored with vector records
P42-P0-014 PostgreSQL constraints must enforce high-value invariants
P42-P0-015 high-value tables must use unique constraints and idempotency keys
P42-P0-016 Alembic migration must be reviewed and reversible
P42-P0-017 autogenerate migration must not be auto-applied
P42-P0-018 schema_version change must trigger compatibility check
P42-P0-019 event_time/decision_time/ingestion_time/label_time must be separated
P42-P0-020 point-in-time correctness is required for training datasets
P42-P0-021 feature_snapshot_manifest must store feature_schema_hash
P42-P0-022 dataset_snapshot_manifest must store dataset_hash
P42-P0-023 final_gate ledger must store actor/reason/before_after/trace_id
P42-P0-024 audit ledger must support row_hash/prev_hash or equivalent tamper evidence
P42-P0-025 delete/retention policy must not break audit replay
P42-P0-026 database credentials/secrets/private account fields must not be stored in business tables
P42-P0-027 backup restore must be tested, not only configured
P42-P0-028 DB permissions and write actions must be auditable
p1_topics: P42-P1-001 pgvector vs Qdrant selection boundary
P42-P1-002 HNSW vs IVFFlat selection boundary
P42-P1-003 Qdrant payload index / metadata filter rule
P42-P1-004 Feast adoption boundary after offline/online parity pressure
P42-P1-005 MLflow registry adoption boundary after release manifest complexity
audit_questions: 是否同意新增 kt.ai_engineering.database_storage_engineering 作为 Phase 42 L2 节点？
12 个 L3 专题是否覆盖交易 AI 数据库、数据契约、审计日志、向量库、迁移、备份恢复和生命周期治理？
34 条知识点是否过多、过少或分类不当？
是否存在把 K 线、fill model、风控、仓位、实盘执行本体混入 AI Engineering 的问题？
是否需要新增或删除某些 storage_role？
是否应把某些 P1 提升为 P0？
是否存在可能误导 AI IDE 直接创建生产数据库或执行迁移的表述？
是否存在 reviewed/caveat_only 被误解为 approved/default guidance 的风险？
